newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: STEERS BUYS FRANCHISING FIRM, IN NEW TALKS.
newsitem.headline: STEERS BUYS FRANCHISING FIRM, IN NEW TALKS.

text.p: South African fastfood group, Steers Holdings Ltd, said on Friday it is to buy the businesses of Speciality Franchising Trust for a maximum consideration of 25 million rand.

It said the purchase comprises a regional licence for Steers in the KwaZulu Natal province and a central kitchen to distribute product to its franchised outlets. It also includes the business of pizza franchiser and take-away, Debonairs.
Steers said the buy will allow it to take full advantage of its licence in that province, integrate its suppliers and add a new dimension to its food operations.
Steers said talks in respect of a further acquisition were in progress which successful could have a material effect on its share price. It advised caution in dealing in its shares.
